channel.title: BCG Institute（原 Henderson）· 最新洞察
channel.description: 原Henderson官网实际跳转的BCG Institute页面，限定Latest Insights八张文章卡片，排除订阅、团队和其他导航。

item.title: AI and the Business of Nature Conservation
item.description: AI has sharpened conservationists’ view of nature’s decline. The bigger opportunity is to change the products and practices driving the loss.

item.title: Global Power Is Shifting. How Can Leaders Adapt?
item.description: Understanding how to operate in an increasingly multipolar world is crucial for leaders looking to protect their business and the ability to operate internationally.

item.title: The Next-Gen Strategist in the Age of AI
item.description: As AI commoditizes analytical thinking, strategists must foster new modes of thinking—and select the right one to tackle the challenges faced by their firm.

item.title: AI Talk Is Cheap. Value Creation Is Rare.
item.description: BCG Institute’s latest analysis uses an outside-in measure to identify what separates AI leaders from everyone else, and what it takes to join them.

item.title: Redesigning Climate Resilience for a World of Financial Tipping Points
item.description: The growing risk of climate-induced financial tipping points requires cooperation among businesses, insurers, and policymakers.

item.title: The Great Divide: How the US and China Are Splitting the AI World
item.description: The AI superpowers—the US and China—are creating two increasingly incompatible tech stacks. For companies, the window for mixing the two may be closing.

item.title: When Everyone Uses AI, Companies Risk Losing Critical Skills
item.description: AI brings efficiencies, but overreliance can cause cognitive skills within organizations to erode. Leaders should act now to protect human capabilities.

item.title: Beyond Tomorrow: Four Scenarios for the World of 2050
item.description: Long-term thinking can seem like a luxury. But understanding the possibilities can provide lessons for addressing today’s challenges.
